blocks.text: ASUNCION, Paraguay—Paraguay‘s Senate on Friday impeached President Santiago Peña over a banking crisis that left millions of people unable to access their deposits. Senators voted overwhelmingly to remove Peña from office over the implosion of Ueno bank, one of the country’s biggest, with which he had ties. /apl
